Wild Rhinox
A beast's terrifying strength comes from its powerfully muscled haunches - the charge of a Rhinox is utterly devastating.

Massive, shaggy, and foul-tempered, the Rhinox is an enormous and dangerous horned beast that lowers its horns and charges at anything blocking its path, no matter how massive the creature in its way.
Wild Stonehorn
The Stonehorn is exceptionally volatile - its first instinct upon spotting any creature is simply to charge.
This mammoth-like creature possesses every quality an Ogre could desire: size, brutality, strength, and toughness - naturally earning it great reverence among the Ogres.
